name: Put/call extreme with news-sentiment pessimism confluence (options+headline consensus, long)
rationale: MECHANISM: variant of the options-capitulation confluence that cross-checks put/call against NEWS sentiment rather than the fear_greed composite. Extreme put/call (informed hedging) plus a deeply negative news backdrop (headline-driven pessimism) is a different flavor of consensus: the professional hedge is reacting to the same bearish headline flow the retail crowd sees, and when BOTH are stretched the over-hedge unwind is the mechanical buy pressure. Tests whether the options-sentiment edge is robust to which retail-pessimism gauge confirms it. Long spot; exit when put/call normalizes or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER: verify putcall_ratio per-symbol coverage FIRST (likely BTC/ETH-only, short history) — thin N cannot clear FDR. If put/call adds nothing once you control for news_sentiment, it is redundant — kill. If the confluence result is identical to the fear_greed-confluence variant, the two are one signal — keep the better-covered one.
catalyst: extreme put/call hedging alongside deeply negative news sentiment
